description: Checks a report definition (RDL or RDLC) or Markdown with SSRS2's engine (Report Viewer's rules): XML, schema, every expression compiled, then a run with rows through every page. Returns ok, a summary and diagnostics (code, severity, item, property, expression, line, message, hint); atRunTime counts what failed as it ran (#Error cells). Call it after each change until ok is true and atRunTime absent. Expressions are Visual Basic and may only compute (restrictedCode). Also layout, expect, variants, rowCounts and the report as it was (baselineRdlc): help: ["checks"].

baselineRdlc.description: The report as it was (its XML): only new warnings are said, with pages before.

culture.description: The culture of a report that names no Language (en-US, de-CH); left out, en-US.

expect.description: Rules: {"order": ["role:table", "Block?", "role:signature"]}, samePage, page, pages, maxPages, noOverlap. An item named and not printed fails its rule, unless written Name? (a variant may hide it).

help.description: true, or topics (["markdown", "decks"]): the reference only.

layout.description: true, or names and roles (role:signature): where each item printed, its page and place in cm.

madeUpRows.description: "all": every made-up row in the answer, not a summary.

markdown.description: Markdown's text: a document, or slides with marp: true. Give rdlc or markdown.

parameters.description: Report parameter values by name (a multi-value one's separated by commas).

pictures.description: The pictures the Markdown names, by its paths: {"images/chart.png": "<base64>"}; 5 MB each, 20 MB in all.

rdlc.description: The report definition's XML (RDL or RDLC). Give rdlc or markdown.

render.description: false: the definition only, no expression runs.

rowCounts.description: {"Requests": "1..30"}: the pages of each count and the first that adds a page.

sampleData.description: Rows per dataset: {"DataSet": [{"Field": value}]}, dates as ISO text. Left out, made up from the fields' types.

variants.description: Renders again with rows changed: [{"name": "no deposit", "sampleData": {"Deposit": null}}].

name: validate_report
title: Validate a report
